text-field.$note: Shared visual foundation for all text-input-style components (input, select, textarea, date-picker). Components reference this base — changing it changes all text fields uniformly.

textarea.$note: Extends text-field but replaces fixed height with min-height. No icon slots — trailing/leading icons don't apply to multi-line input.
textarea.$exception: Textarea min-heights are hardcoded — content-area minimums specific to multi-line input, not derivable from sizing primitives.

toggle-base.$note: Shared size ladder for the binary toggles: the size of the indicator. What draws inside it is each toggle's own.
toggle-base.$exception: Toggle indicator sizes are hardcoded — proportional to the control's visual weight, not derived from icon or component-height primitives.

checkbox.$note: Drawn by the class layer, as radio is: a box with a border, and a tick or an indeterminate dash on its ::before, a currentColor fill cut to shape with clip-path. With appearance: none the input renders the pseudo-element; native accent-color let the browser pick the tick's colour, which put a white tick on a light dark-mode primary. The indeterminate state takes the checked fill. The box radius follows the brand's component radius, capped so a small box never becomes a circle.

radio.$note: Drawn by the class layer, as switch is: a circle with a border, and a dot that is a radial gradient taking currentColor. Native accent-color let the browser pick the dot's colour from the fill's lightness, which put a white dot on a light dark-mode primary; drawn, the dot is on-primary on primary in every browser. Exclusive within a name group. No radius token: the shape is a circle.

switch.$exception: Switch track dimensions are hardcoded as a cohesive set — width:height ratio is intentional and should not drift independently via primitives.

form-field.$note: A column with a gap, and nothing that ramps — so it declares only a $constant, which lifts to the base rule. A component in APPEARANCE_ONLY with no schema at all emits nothing, and the atom ends up carrying the layout itself — which is what the $constant is here to prevent. The gap is {scale.2}, not the {scale.1} the other components here use, because it has to clear the focus ring: the ring reaches --focus-ring-offset plus --focus-ring-width past the control, which equals {scale.1}, so at that gap a focused field's ring touched its label and its helper text.

helper-text.$note: Subordinate to the label by colour alone. label and action read one size ramp at one weight, so the only separation left is on-surface-variant against on-surface.
